# Blueberry Basement - Android and Minit Games

> Meeting Mayhem is a free calendar scheduling puzzle game for Android on Google Play: slide meetings into open time slots, clear overlaps, solve schedule puzzles, use power-ups, and complete daily tasks in short sessions.

Blueberry Basement is an indie label by Szymon Borowka. Blueberry Basement also creates short-form games for Minit Games as @blueberrybasement. This static site is the public home for its games: it summarizes gameplay, shows screenshots, answers common questions, links to the official Play Store listing, and hosts privacy and terms pages linked from the app.

The site is English-only. Meeting Mayhem is available for Android through the official Google Play listing below.

## Site

- [Meeting Mayhem landing page](https://blueberrybasement.com/): Game overview, screenshots, features, common questions, and the official Android download link.
- [Articles](https://blueberrybasement.com/articles/): Guides to Meeting Mayhem rules and scheduling puzzle strategy, plus the story behind the mobile game.
- [Calendar Puzzle Games: How Scheduling Puzzles Work](https://blueberrybasement.com/articles/calendar-puzzle-game.html): Defines scheduling puzzles, explains Meeting Mayhem rules and calendar limits, and distinguishes digital scheduling from physical calendar puzzles.
- [10 Free Android Puzzle Games for Short Sessions](https://blueberrybasement.com/articles/free-android-puzzle-games-short-sessions.html): Top 10 list of quick-play Android puzzle games, including Flow Free, Two Dots, Unblock Me, Meeting Mayhem, Sudoku.com, Infinity Loop, Blockudoku, Brain It On!, Puzzledom, and KAMI 2.
- [How to Solve Overlapping Meeting Puzzles](https://blueberrybasement.com/articles/how-to-solve-overlapping-meeting-puzzles.html): Strategy for comparing continuous gaps, respecting locked events, moving meetings across days, and freeing scarce destinations.
- [Meeting Mayhem Gameplay Guide](https://blueberrybasement.com/articles/meeting-mayhem-gameplay-guide.html): Android controls, fixed meeting duration, calendar limits, win condition, single-step Undo, and an overview of daily tasks and the Lucky Spinner.
- [How a Crowded Work Calendar Inspired Meeting Mayhem](https://blueberrybasement.com/articles/designing-meeting-mayhem-puzzles.html): How a heavily filled work calendar inspired the game and how daily tasks and the Lucky Spinner supported its hybrid-casual direction.

- [Meeting Mayhem Daily Tasks and Lucky Spinner Explained](https://blueberrybasement.com/articles/meeting-mayhem-daily-tasks-and-spinner.html): How task progress differs from claimed rewards, what a UTC reset means, and where the Lucky Spinner fits into mobile play.
- [What Makes a Scheduling Puzzle Difficult?](https://blueberrybasement.com/articles/what-makes-scheduling-puzzles-difficult.html): Why a crowded calendar is not always a hard puzzle, and how duration, locked events and connected moves shape difficulty.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://blueberrybasement.com/privacy.html): What the Android app may collect, AI-related disclosures, third-party SDKs (e.g. Google Play Services, AdMob, Firebase, Unity), retention, children's privacy, and contact.
- [Terms of Use](https://blueberrybasement.com/terms.html): License, acceptable use, third-party terms references, liability, updates, and contact.

## Minit Games

Blueberry Basement publishes Meeting Mayhem, Lucky Lane, Ashen Ascent, Rainbow Roll and Riot Road on Minit Games. The Minit adaptation of Meeting Mayhem is separate from its Android app; Android daily tasks, spinner and progression are not features of the Minit edition. Each play link below opens a particular published Post, whose challenge may differ from other Posts of the same game.

- [Our Minit Games](https://blueberrybasement.com/minit-games.html): Game collection and official play links.
- [Meeting Mayhem on Minit Games](https://play.minit.games/play/lcdt02oz14): Move meetings, work around locked events and clear calendar overlaps. A compact adaptation of our Android puzzle game.
- [Lucky Lane on Minit Games](https://play.minit.games/play/hj5x0w0jxw): Roll around a gold-filled board as safe spaces turn into skulls. Shields protect a landing, but every roll changes the risk.
- [Ashen Ascent on Minit Games](https://play.minit.games/play/02np9s5fw6): Aim each jump and climb from ledge to ledge toward the crown. A missed landing can end the run.
- [Rainbow Roll on Minit Games](https://play.minit.games/play/m8pdgfd0fi): Guide a ball across winding paths, narrow bridges and steep ramps. Collect coins while keeping enough control to reach the finish.
- [Riot Road on Minit Games](https://play.minit.games/play/9be4hlwmta): Steer an automatically firing squad, recruit soldiers and collect stronger weapons. Dodge enemy attacks and fight through to the bosses.
- [What Is Minit Games, and Why Are We Making Games for It?](https://blueberrybasement.com/articles/why-we-make-minit-games.html): Why Blueberry Basement is building for Minit Games: short, self-contained games, touch controls and different challenges from one game.
- [Our Games on Minit: Puzzles, Platformers and a Squad Shooter](https://blueberrybasement.com/articles/our-games-on-minit.html): Explore five Blueberry Basement games on Minit Games, with gameplay summaries and direct play links for puzzles, platformers, dice survival and shooting.
- [Meeting Mayhem on Android and Minit: What Changes?](https://blueberrybasement.com/articles/meeting-mayhem-android-and-minit.html): Compare Meeting Mayhem on Google Play with its Minit adaptation: the same calendar puzzle idea, with different session structure and surrounding features.
